units.title: join evidence correction
units.instructions: Assigned boundary: T012. Extend the existing 007 transformation producer with optional typed declared join and observed join evidence; historical absent fields remain unavailable and never imply a known join. Export validateTransformationJoinV1(value, inputVersionRefs). A known join has joinId, kind (inner/left/right/full), and nonempty keyMappings of leftVersionRef/leftKey/rightVersionRef/rightKey. Exact refs must belong to distinct declared input versions; key strings must be nonempty; duplicate mappings, unknown keys and kinds are invalid. Add optional join to TransformationDeclarationV1 and TransformationObservationsV1; validate known values via the exported helper and retain observed mismatches as evidence, not a fabricated pass. Existing legacy fixtures must still work. Keep immutable digest validation including the optional fields; do not rewrite old committed records. Add tests through both real declaration/manifest validators for a valid two-input join, foreign ref, empty mapping, invalid kind, duplicate mapping, tampered digest, observed different join and absent legacy evidence. Run the external analytics-join-probe.mjs through tsx plus the whole existing 007 test file. Record that this is a corrective successor to accepted 007 T002, not a relabeling of its historical acceptance. Preserve existing tests and frozen product requirements. Add passing real-entry-point tests named scope:007-join-evidence-correction: with a valid control and each listed rejection. Do not implement later boundaries. Explicit corrective ownership includes src/analytics/measurement.ts::reconcileDenominatorLineageV1: when declared and observed join identities, kinds or key mappings differ, denominator reconciliation MUST retain the observed mismatch and MUST NOT report a pass from matching counts/cardinality alone. Unknown historical join evidence remains unknown rather than invented. Add a real reconciliation regression with matching counts/cardinality and different valid observed join, plus a matching-join control. This is a corrective successor to historical T003 as well as T002; historical accepted records remain unchanged. The assigned local acceptance includes this consumer behavior; it is not deferred to T003. Do not route this assigned defect as a missing producer.
